reason: PURE. First thing I looked at was '200 mg, fully chelated, no magnesium oxide' on the front, that is what I check for, and a named ISO 17025 lab with a batch report is more than most brands give me. I would buy one box of the plain bisglycinate to try; the complex with three forms I'd skip since the bisglycinate part is only 60 mg.
objection: 'Lab-tested' with a QR code is what everybody says, and I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles. I would open the QR before I trust it, and if the report is vague or not for my batch, I'm out.
would_change_my_mind: A QR report that actually opens to a real batch result with the magnesium content and heavy metals numbers, plus a clear label showing the dose per capsule.
